import json,sys,pathlib
root=pathlib.Path(sys.argv[1])
for name,body in json.loads(sys.argv[2]).items():
 p=root/name
 with p.open('a' if sys.argv[3]=='true' else 'w',encoding='utf-8') as f: f.write(body)

Abstraction: one constructor/publication slot feeding one selected Cache receiver, then occupancy/capacity leaf states with key membership, ordering, mutex status, callback registration and per-call delivery as guarded context. Uninitialized means no valid store. Empty is capacity > 0 and count = 0; BelowCapacity is 0 < count < capacity; AtCapacity is count = capacity > 0; Disabled is capacity = 0; NegativeCapacity is capacity < 0 (possibly nonempty after overflow). The main grid uses a live, unstranded receiver unless a fault cell says otherwise. Constructor creates a different receiver if one is already selected. A row with several branches declares one representative target and gives alternate targets in text/guards. Impossibilities are defensive dispositions, not emitted runtime errors.
